provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the CGU of opendata.justice-administrative.fr (version of 18 January 2022, Licence Ouverte 2.0). The site states it 'ne comporte pas d'API' and sets no rate limit: this package calls the JSON interface of the site's own search engine (/recherche/api/...), undocumented and liable to change. Obligations: name the source (the Conseil d'État's Open Data base, a hyperlink allowed) and show the load date clearly; no alteration, no detaching a decision from its context or reformulating it, a partial reproduction shown as such, commentary kept apart; keep the data up to date; never use judges' and clerks' identity to evaluate their practice (criminal offence); report any re-identifying element to the contact address.
